contexts.text: Prey in mine house () = remains in the internal man, which are compared to prey, because they are as it were furtively insinuated among so many evils and falsities.
Prey = truths which had been falsified.
To despoil () = to destroy.
They despoiled () = they perverted them.
From the prey, my son, thou hast gone up () = that from the Lord, through the Celestial, there is the deliverance of many from Hell. Explained. AC 6442 Illustrated. AE 433:4.

In the evening he shall divide the prey () = their possession in the Lord's Kingdom while they are as yet in obscurity... To divide the prey = to give a possession in the heavenly Kingdom; for by the prey are signified those who are snatched away and delivered by the Lord; hence by to divide the prey is signified distribution, namely, among those who are in Heaven...
The spoiling of the Egyptians. Explained. AC 7770.
The spoiling of the nations in the Land of Canaan, Explained.
To spoil = to take away.
To spoil the sons of the east () = to receive and take into possession the interior goods of faith.
Deprive, nay, despoil others.
The despoilings of their wealth (permitted). (Explained.)
The prey from which he has gone up = the dissipation of falsities and evils.
The prey, and food () = the good which is of love, and the truth which is of wisdom.
They have become a prey () = that they have fallen by evils...
To be for a prey, and for a spoil, = devastation. AE 601:12.
Occurs.
To lay hold of the prey () = the deliverance... of those who are in truths from good.
Prey = the falsification of truth.
To fall by captivity and by spoil () = the deprivation of all truth and good.
